messages:
Maya: Heads-up 1: ACME just pushed for CompetitorY parity on per-tenant routing + tamper-proof audit logs. They said competitor won their deal on that. Can we scope something acceptable for a Q1 pilot?

Jasper: Summary from eng: two realistic paths: 1) narrow "parity shim" (tenant model pins + namespaced KV + write-only audit events) or 2) full routing graph feature (multi-rule DAG, UI, replay). Shim is 2-3 sprint work; full graph is multiple teams and infra plumb.

Arnav: Important commercial note: ACME insists on cryptographically verifiable audit trail (append-only hashes). That bumps legal/compliance and may require HSM integration down the line. For pilot we can do signed logs but call out that HSM-backed retention is roadmap.

Priya: From quality: we should require an automated regression suite against ACME's canonical prompts. Acceptance metric: semantic similarity (embedding cosine) drop <= 3% and hallucination delta <= 1% on labeled set. We'll include an automated canary check that aborts rollout if triggered.

Liam: On SLOs: ACME wants p95 <= 120ms for small prompts (<256 tokens). We can't promise that for quantized variants on older GPUs. Need explicit supported model list and a fallback-grade with slower latency but stable quality.

Sofia: Sales will push for a pilot commitment if we can promise pilot liftoff within 6 weeks and a clear upgrade path. They prefer pilot scoped to 5 tenants, region EU-WEST-1, and no more than 200 QPS combined.

Jasper: Proposal for MVP-shim scope: tenant model pin, per-tenant KV namespace, eventing hook that writes signed audit lines to S3 (append-only), and a feature flag `tenant.routing.shim`. No UI, no cross-tenant routing, single region, and explicit supported-model list.

Maya: What are the rollback/guardrail mechanics we need?

Jasper: Canary + abort if: latency p95 > 200ms for 5m window, error rate > 2%, or similarity drop > 5%. Also automatic disable for that tenant key if cross-tenant cache detected.

Priya: Observability: must emit metrics: shim_enabled, tenant_cache_conflicts, audit_events_written, similarity_drop_pct. Also trace attributes for routed_model and pinned_model.

Arnav: Legal asks we include an explicit data-handling note in the pilot TOS: logs are stored for 30 days, signed events for audit only, HSM option as paid upgrade. I'll draft language.

Liam: Engineering estimate: 2 backend engs + 1 infra/sre for 6 weeks to deliver shim and metrics, plus an eval engineer for harness. Full graph would be 3 teams over multiple quarters.

Sofia: Pricing ask: Sales wants a one-time pilot fee to cover infra and premium support. Finance needs a simple cost estimate for the pilot.

Maya: Roadmap impact: we can treat the shim as a short-term parity play but label "experimental-parity" in public roadmap. We should also log the full graph as "investigate" for next quarter as a product initiative.

Jasper: Example YAML for shim config (internal API):

```yaml
tenant: acme-enterprise
pinned_model: redwood-llama-7b-q4f16
supported_models:
  - redwood-llama-7b-q4f16
  - redwood-ggml-6b-q4
prefix_rules:
  - "/customer/"
audit_sink: s3://acme-audit-logs/pilot
fallback: route-to-stable
```

Sofia: We need this spelled out in the pilot email: scope, limits, rollback triggers, and the pilot fee. I'll prepare a template.

Maya: Action items: Jasper -> design doc + ENG ETA (3 working days), Priya -> regression harness plan + similarity thresholds (EOW), Arnav -> draft pilot TOS and HSM note (EOW), Liam -> perf matrix for supported models (3 days), Sofia -> pilot commercial template & pilot fee estimate (EOW), Legal-bot -> please surface any regulatory blockers.

legal-bot: Reviewed. No immediate regulatory blockers for signed S3 logs in EU region; advise encryption-at-rest and retention policy.

deploy-bot: Canary window request queued for 2025-02-10 04:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

Maya: If we can meet the similarity and latency gates, we offer ACME the pilot. Let's keep the shim scope tight and communicate clearly it's a bridge, not the final routing graph.

Jasper: I'll post the initial design doc to the product drive and schedule a tech review.

Priya: Will wire up the first regression run once we have sample prompts.

Sofia: Sales will get the draft to ACME legal after Arnav and Legal-bot sign off.

Maya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene in 48h with updates.
